_doc: Owner-curated overrides for the MLB Free Agency module, keyed by
player_key. Consumed by fa_export at export time — nothing here
touches the model or the gates; it is disclosure and curation only.
two_way  (bool)  — two-way profile. The market model prices ONE
profile (whichever the corpus carries), so the
prediction is a FLOOR. Adds the standard caveat
note unless a custom `note` is given. Worked
example: Ohtani '23 — model would have said
5y/$173M off the age-29 SP line; he signed
note     (str)   — owner note, shown verbatim on the board tooltip
exclude  (bool)  — drop the row from the exported class entirely
Keys starting with '_' are documentation and are ignored.
